ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a basketball player shooting on the right side, with the release point marked as 2 m above the ground; the horizontal distance from the vertical dashed line at the release point to the vertical dashed line where the backboard is located is marked as 4 m. The red horizontal edge of the basket on the left side is at a height of 3 m above the ground. The enlarged view marks that the end of the basket near the backboard is 15 cm from the backboard, and the diameter of the basket is 50 cm. The backboard is a vertical plane, and the dashed blue trajectory indicates that the ball first hits the backboard and then rebounds into the basket. Reasoning: The problem requires that the size of the ball may be ignored in this problem, so there is no need to consider a 0.1 m radius correction. The backboard collision is perfectly elastic and frictionless, so when hitting the vertical backboard, only the direction of the horizontal velocity changes, and the vertical velocity remains unchanged. The reflection unfolding method can be used: mirror the target point after the rebound to behind the backboard, so that the actual broken-line path is equivalent to an ordinary parabola directly reaching the mirrored target point. To make the initial velocity the smallest, the target point that can enter the basket and is closest to the backboard should be selected, namely the near edge of the basket, 0.15 m from the backboard. After mirroring, this point is 0.15 m behind the backboard. The release point is 4 m from the backboard, so the unfolded horizontal displacement is Δx = 4 + 0.15 = 4.15 m. The height of the basket is 3 m, and the release height is 2 m, so the vertical displacement is Δy = 1 m. The minimum projectile speed to reach a given point satisfies v_min^2 = g(Δy + sqrt(Δx^2 + Δy^2)). Substituting Δx = 4.15 m, Δy = 1 m, g = 9.8 m/s^2: v_min^2 = 9.8(1 + sqrt(4.15^2 + 1^2)) = 9.8(1 + sqrt(18.2225)) ≈ 51.63, therefore v_min ≈ 7.19 m/s.

raw_record.question_text:
In the following two problems we will look at shooting a basketball. Model the basketball as an elastic hollow sphere with radius 0.1 meters. Model the net and basket as shown below, dimensions marked. Neglect friction between the backboard and basketball, and assume all collisions are perfectly elastic.

For this problem, you launch the basketball from the point that is 2 meters above the ground and 4 meters from the backboard as shown. You attempt to make a shot by hitting the basketball off the backboard as depicted above. What is the minimum initial speed required for the ball to make this shot?
Note: For this problem, you may assume that the size of the ball is negligible.

method.method_draft: Use an unfolded-image/reflection construction. First read the diagram: the shooter releases the ball at height 2 m and is 4 m horizontally from the vertical backboard; the rim is at height 3 m; the front/nearest edge of the hoop is 15 cm from the backboard and the rim diameter is 50 cm. From the text, use the assumptions that the ball size is negligible and the backboard collision is perfectly elastic with no friction. Because an elastic collision with a vertical wall reverses only the horizontal velocity, replace the post-bounce path by a straight-through projectile path to the mirror image of the hoop point behind the backboard. For minimum speed, target the closest admissible rim point, the near edge 0.15 m from the backboard, so the unfolded projectile must go from the release point to a point 4.15 m horizontally away and 1 m higher. Then apply the standard minimum projectile speed formula for reaching a point: v_min^2 = g(Delta y + sqrt(Delta x^2 + Delta y^2)), with Delta x = 4.15 m and Delta y = 1 m, giving about 7.19 m/s.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图显示篮球运动员在右侧出手，出手点标为离地 2 m；从出手点竖直虚线到篮板所在竖直虚线的水平距离标为 4 m。左侧篮筐红色水平边位于离地 3 m 高度。放大图标出篮筐靠近篮板的一端距离篮板 15 cm，篮筐直径为 50 cm。篮板为竖直面，虚线蓝色轨迹表示球先打到篮板再反弹入篮。

推理：题目要求本题可忽略球的大小，所以不需要考虑 0.1 m 半径修正。篮板碰撞完全弹性且无摩擦，因此撞到竖直篮板时只改变水平速度方向，竖直速度不变。可用反射展开法：把反弹后的目标点镜像到篮板后方，使实际的折线路径等效为一条普通抛物线直接到达镜像目标点。

为使初速度最小，应选最接近篮板的可进篮目标点，即篮筐近边，距篮板 0.15 m。镜像后，该点在篮板后方 0.15 m。出手点离篮板 4 m，所以展开后的水平位移为 Δx = 4 + 0.15 = 4.15 m。篮筐高度 3 m，出手高度 2 m，所以竖直位移为 Δy = 1 m。

到达给定点的最小抛射速度满足 v_min^2 = g(Δy + sqrt(Δx^2 + Δy^2))。代入 Δx = 4.15 m、Δy = 1 m、g = 9.8 m/s^2：v_min^2 = 9.8(1 + sqrt(4.15^2 + 1^2)) = 9.8(1 + sqrt(18.2225)) ≈ 51.63，因此 v_min ≈ 7.19 m/s。

method.method_draft: Solve the motion explicitly as two projectile segments joined by a wall bounce. From the diagram, set the backboard at x = 0, the release point at x = 4 m and y = 2 m, and the rim height at y = 3 m. The admissible scoring interval begins 0.15 m in front of the backboard and extends to 0.65 m because the hoop diameter is 50 cm; for minimum speed, test the nearest entry point x = 0.15 m since it requires the least horizontal range. From the text, ignore ball radius and use a perfectly elastic frictionless bounce, so the vertical velocity is unchanged at impact and the horizontal velocity changes sign. Let the launch velocity components be v_x < 0 and v_y. Write projectile equations until the wall hit: x(t_b)=0, y(t_b)=2+v_y t_b-(1/2)g t_b^2. After impact, use horizontal velocity -v_x and the same vertical velocity at t_b, then require the ball to pass through x=0.15 m, y=3 m at a later time. Equivalently eliminate the bounce time to obtain the same condition as a projectile covering total unfolded horizontal distance 4.15 m and vertical rise 1 m. Minimize v_x^2+v_y^2 over the remaining flight time or launch angle to get v_min = sqrt(g(1 + sqrt(4.15^2+1^2))) ≈ 7.19 m/s.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图显示篮球从右侧球员手中出手，出手点高度标为 2 m；球员到篮板所在竖直线的水平距离标为 4 m。左侧篮筐高度标为 3 m。放大图标出篮筐前缘离篮板 15 cm，篮筐直径 50 cm，所以可进球的水平区间从离篮板 0.15 m 到 0.65 m。蓝色虚线轨迹表示球先撞到竖直篮板，再反弹进入篮筐。推理：按题意本题忽略球半径，且篮板碰撞完全弹性、无摩擦，因此撞板时水平速度反向，竖直速度不变。取篮板为 x=0，出手点为 x=4 m, y=2 m，篮筐高度 y=3 m。为使初速度最小，选最近的入筐点 x=0.15 m，因为这给出最小的展开水平距离。把反弹运动展开为等效无反弹抛体运动：球需要完成的总水平距离为 R=4+0.15=4.15 m，竖直升高为 h=3-2=1 m。设总飞行时间为 T，则水平速度大小为 R/T，竖直初速度为 v_y=h/T+(gT)/2。故初速度平方为 v^2=(R/T)^2+(h/T+gT/2)^2=(R^2+h^2)/T^2+gh+g^2T^2/4。对 T 最小化得 T^2=2 sqrt(R^2+h^2)/g，并且 v_min^2=g(h+sqrt(R^2+h^2))。代入 R=4.15 m, h=1 m, g=9.8 m/s^2：v_min=sqrt(9.8*(1+sqrt(4.15^2+1^2)))≈7.19 m/s。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：附图显示篮球从右侧球员手中出手，出手点高度标为 2 m；球员到篮板所在竖直线的水平距离标为 4 m。左侧篮筐高度标为 3 m。放大图标出篮筐前缘离篮板 15 cm，篮筐直径 50 cm，所以可进球的水平区间从离篮板 0.15 m 到 0.65 m。蓝色虚线轨迹表示球先撞到竖直篮板，再反弹进入篮筐。推理：按题意本题忽略球半径，且篮板碰撞完全弹性、无摩擦，因此撞板时水平速度反向，竖直速度不变。取篮板为 x=0，出手点为 x=4 m, y=2 m，篮筐高度 y=3 m。为使初速度最小，选最近的入筐点 x=0.15 m，因为这给出最小的展开水平距离。把反弹运动展开为等效无反弹抛体运动：球需要完成的总水平距离为 R=4+0.15=4.15 m，竖直升高为 h=3-2=1 m。设总飞行时间为 T，则水平速度大小为 R/T，竖直初速度为 v_y=h/T+(gT)/2。故初速度平方为 v^2=(R/T)^2+(h/T+gT/2)^2=(R^2+h^2)/T^2+gh+g^2T^2/4。对 T 最小化得 T^2=2 sqrt(R^2+h^2)/g，并且 v_min^2=g(h+sqrt(R^2+h^2))。代入 R=4.15 m, h=1 m, g=9.8 m/s^2：v_min=sqrt(9.8*(1+sqrt(4.15^2+1^2)))≈7.19 m/s。

raw_record.original_question:
In the following two problems we will look at shooting a basketball. Model the basketball as an elastic hollow sphere with radius 0.1 meters. Model the net and basket as shown below, dimensions marked. Neglect friction between the backboard and basketball, and assume all collisions are perfectly elastic.

For this problem, you launch the basketball from the point that is 2 meters above the ground and 4 meters from the backboard as shown. You attempt to make a shot by hitting the basketball off the backboard as depicted above. What is the minimum initial speed required for the ball to make this shot?
Note: For this problem, you may assume that the size of the ball is negligible.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: The attached figure shows a basketball player shooting on the right side, with the release point marked as 2 m above the ground; the horizontal distance from the vertical dashed line at the release point to the vertical dashed line where the backboard is located is marked as 4 m. The red horizontal edge of the basket on the left side is at a height of 3 m above the ground. The enlarged view marks that the end of the basket near the backboard is 15 cm from the backboard, and the diameter of the basket is 50 cm. The backboard is a vertical plane, and the dashed blue trajectory indicates that the ball first hits the backboard and then rebounds into the basket.

Reasoning: The problem requires that the size of the ball may be ignored in this problem, so there is no need to consider a 0.1 m radius correction. The backboard collision is perfectly elastic and frictionless, so when hitting the vertical backboard, only the direction of the horizontal velocity changes, and the vertical velocity remains unchanged. The reflection unfolding method can be used: mirror the target point after the rebound to behind the backboard, so that the actual broken-line path is equivalent to an ordinary parabola directly reaching the mirrored target point.

To make the initial velocity the smallest, the target point that can enter the basket and is closest to the backboard should be selected, namely the near edge of the basket, 0.15 m from the backboard. After mirroring, this point is 0.15 m behind the backboard. The release point is 4 m from the backboard, so the unfolded horizontal displacement is Δx = 4 + 0.15 = 4.15 m. The height of the basket is 3 m, and the release height is 2 m, so the vertical displacement is Δy = 1 m.

The minimum projectile speed to reach a given point satisfies v_min^2 = g(Δy + sqrt(Δx^2 + Δy^2)). Substituting Δx = 4.15 m, Δy = 1 m, g = 9.8 m/s^2: v_min^2 = 9.8(1 + sqrt(4.15^2 + 1^2)) = 9.8(1 + sqrt(18.2225)) ≈ 51.63, therefore v_min ≈ 7.19 m/s.
